C200.notes: SER AS-TW-001. Both-sides photos · user shorthand Both sides of one coin. Obverse Chiang Kai-shek left · 中華民國六十七年 (Republic of China Year 67 = 1978 Gregorian). Reverse 壹圓 · 1. Everyday Taiwan dollar of the late Chiang era — wet-market / bus / night-market weight. Country #29 — first Taiwan / ROC · second East Asia after Hong Kong C146. Taiwan flips now 1.
C200.story: A 2008 1 yuan from Taiwan (Republic of China). The obverse shows Chiang Kai-shek facing left, with 中華民國九十七年 (Republic of China year 97, which is 2008); the reverse shows 壹圓 and 1. Struck in aluminium-bronze.
